text: Applicants are required to upload scanned copies of the following application documents to the application system. 1. Non-criminal record certificate issued by the local police force. 2.A letter of financial support or bank statements of the last six months from parents (including guardians). 3. Application form, passport, transcripts, high school graduation certificate or notarized documents (those who have not graduated at the time of application can provide pre-graduation certificate). 4. HSK4 Score Report (for Chinese-taught program applicants) 5. TOEFL IBT or lELTS Score Report (if available) (for English-taught program applicants whose native language is not English) 6. Physical examination form for foreigners (medical examination results valid for 6 months)7. A passport-size electronic photo taken in the past three months. 8. Other documents that may be required by HZCU to make corrections or submit.
